items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: we were discussing what influence Bobby Hackett was on me.

ctx.x: You know, now that I was thinking back on it, we were discussing what influence Bobby Hackett was on me. And I can remember now, every night on the radio, maybe 8 o'clock, 9 o'clock at night, I had to be in the late 40s again, 48, 49, or 50. They had an hour of recorded music, sentimental or ballads. And quite often they played the Jackie Gleason records with Bobby Hackett. The original Gleason Hackett things with songs like Alone Together and My Funny Valentine. And that is the first I remember hearing of Bobby…
I don't think I ever owned that album.
